name: Humanitarian funding gap
summary: WFP seeks $12.1bn to help 91 million people in 2027 amid constrained funding; ration cuts continue
state: WFP's 2027 Global Outlook, issued on 20 Nov, seeks $12.1 billion to assist 91 million people and says constrained funding is forcing hard choices. WFP said on 19 Oct that funding cuts meant about half a million people in Gaza would lose assistance and rations were halved to one parcel. Major ration cuts meet Watch; searches on 28 Nov found no large-scale suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country.
for_you: People relying on food aid in Gaza, Sudan and other crisis areas are most exposed. Ration cuts tend to show up in rising malnutrition months later.
rubric_hit: Watch: major ration cuts announced (WFP Gaza caseload cut by about 500,000); no large-scale aid suspension found

sources.title: WFP — Funding cuts force WFP to drastically reduce lifesaving assistance in Gaza

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
